purpose_context: Crest Synth's interface is painted today by a single adapter file holding seven hand-entered colors that do not match the approved visual design, with no typeface loaded at all. This mission establishes the shared visual vocabulary taken directly from the Figma design system - semantic colors, type styles, spacing, and focus treatments - plus the small reusable pieces that the later Patch and Mixer screens are assembled from, and a gallery screen rendering every meaningful state at both desktop and Steam Deck sizes so the result can be judged by looking at it rather than by reading a log.
purpose_tldr: Give Crest Synth one shared source for every color, font, and measurement so the real screen finally matches the approved design.
source_description: Phase 4 (ROADMAP.md:170-184), first of two missions. Vocabulary, primitives, gallery scene, and production-shell repaint; controls, compositions, and demo-live-component-library deferred to the follow-on mission.
